articles.text: WÈI SHÀOXIÀO: Nǐ zhù zai nǎli?
MAJOR WEISS: Where are you staying?
LǏ XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ zhù zai péngyou jiā.
MR. LǏ: I'm staying at a friend's house.
WÈI SHÀOXIÀO: Nǐ péngyoude dìzhǐ shi...?
MAJOR WEISS: What is your friend's address?
LǏ XIĀNSHENG: Tāde dìzhǐ shi Dàlǐ Jiē Sìshíèrhào. Nǐ zhù zai Guóbīn Dàfàndiàn ba?
MR. LǏ: His address is No. 42 Dàlǐ Street. You're staying at the Ambassador Hotel, aren't you?
WÈI SHÀOXIÀO: Shìde. Nǐ zài nǎli gōngzuò?
MAJOR WEISS: Yes. Where do you work?
LǏ XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ zài yínháng gōngzuò. Nǐ ne?
MR. LǏ: I work at a bank. And you?
WÈI SHÀOXIÀO: Wǒ zài Wǔguānchù gōngzuò. Nǐ péngyou zài Táiběi gōngzuò ma?
MAJOR WEISS: I work at the defense attache's office. Does your friend work in Taipei?
LǏ XIĀNSHENG: Tā bú zài Táiběi gōngzuò; tā zài Táizhōng gōngzuò.
MR. LǏ: He doesn't work in Taipei; he works in Taichung.
